name: Vapi Assistant Hook (setup status into prompt)

parameters.query:
SELECT (cp.setup_completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS setup_complete,
       cp.company_name,
       COALESCE(cp.pm_preferred_name, '') AS pm_preferred_name
  FROM company_profile cp
 WHERE cp.id = COALESCE((SELECT company_id FROM users WHERE id = $1::uuid), 1)
 LIMIT 1;
